answer: Counterparty diversity: full rewards need trades with 12 distinct partners. Each identity holds a cipher key; newcomers wear a saffron tag until they clear it. A clone farm fails: its 1,000 copies trade only with each other, a closed loop flagged each tide of sign-ups. Faking 1,000 identities needs 12,000 trades at 5 POA, 60,000 POA, against 50 POA each. Honest agents pay nothing extra: they trade widely, clear it once, keep their full share.
